description: Un-masked by the 14.7 de-widening. When a now-resolvable closure is re-threaded as a direct-call argument through a recursive continuation (reduce_plain(tail, reducer.(head,acc), reducer)), native must MATERIALIZE it but transport assigns NO boundary: plan.callables[CallableId].boundary_ids==[]. Transport mints boundaries only for first_class_surfaces (callables that escape first-class via record_first_class_demand, runtime_demand.rs); a callable consumed with a resolved call contract and merely passed onward takes callable_for_producer's else{Vec::new()} branch (transport.rs:3649). 14.6 fixed WHICH boundary a first-class callable resolves to, not whether re-threaded resolved callables get one. Reds: native_program_keeps_distinct...capture_identity_differs, carries_published_callable_boundary_targets_into_closure_calls. Bounded transport/abi fix.
title: Transport: mint a callable boundary for re-threaded resolved-call argument callables (native must materialize them)
